source: Existing company-evidence rubric; reused, not newly verified fundamentals or future-return truth.
common: Stocks with production scores and finite rubric/model values; sectors with at least five such stocks.
expanded: All stocks with finite rubric/model values; sectors with at least five such stocks, even if production has fewer than five. No production comparator here.
aggregation: Top-three stocks per sector, then equal sector mean. Excludes Unclassified. Expanded sector set can differ from the common set and older restricted-sector reports.
